name: Leave Application Generator
title: Leave Application Generator (Free, PDF)
description: Write a leave application with the type of leave, dates, number of days and reason. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Choose the type of leave and dates, and print a clear leave application. The number of days is counted for you.
intro: A leave application asks your manager to approve time off. Clear dates, a reason and a contact number help it get approved faster.
The number of days counts both the first and last date. Everything is made in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to BIZEASE.
how: Pick the type of leave (casual, sick, annual, without pay).
Enter the first and last date. The days are counted for you.
Add a short reason and a number where you can be reached.
Print it or save it as a PDF to send.
example: From 1 December 2026 to 3 December 2026 is 3 days of leave. The letter says: "I request sick leave for 3 days, from 1 December 2026 to 3 December 2026."
mistakes: Forgetting to count both start and end dates.
Not giving a contact number for urgent matters.
Applying too late for planned leave.
Not saying who will cover your work.

faq.a: Both the first and the last date are counted, so 1 to 3 December is 3 days. Weekends and holidays inside the range are also counted. Change the wording if your company counts working days only.

faq.q: Is a medical certificate needed for sick leave?
faq.a: Many employers ask for one after a certain number of days. Check your company policy.

faq.q: Can I send it as a PDF?
faq.a: Yes. Use "Print or save as PDF".

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It is a sample format. Your leave entitlement depends on your contract and company policy.
